summary: SuperX AI Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of a new employment agreement with Mr. Jie Yang as Chief Investment Officer and Executive Director, effective August 1, 2026. The one-year term includes an annual base salary of US$360,000 plus housing allowance, with automatic renewals. This is a routine executive compensation arrangement, not a special situation. No terms relate to acquisitions, capital structure, or strategic changes.
